citations.case: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.B.5 (signs and symptoms integral to a definitive diagnosis are not coded separately); Section IV.G and IV.H (outpatient: code the documented definitive diagnosis to the highest level of specificity)

coder_notes: Traps: Coding bilateral or unspecified OA (M17.0, M17.9) when only the right knee is affected and the left is documented asymptomatic; adding integral symptom codes (M25.561 pain, M25.461 effusion, M25.861 crepitus) alongside the definitive diagnosis
